_comment: Hand-maintained list of players CONFIRMED out for the full season. This is the ONLY thing that zeroes a projection. It is deliberately manual: Sleeper's IR flag means 'unavailable now', not 'done for the year' — NFL rules permit return from injured reserve and designated-to-return is routine, so automating IR -> 0 would print false zeros on players who come back. Sleeper's status still drives a visible IR/PUP badge automatically; that is display only. Effects of an entry here: projected PPG goes to 0, an OUT tag appears, and the player is excluded from the accuracy-ledger graded set (a near-zero projection on a player everyone knows is out is not a prediction the model made). Model value and DELTA Score are deliberately NOT touched — the market prices the absence, and the DELTA Score picks it up on its own at the offseason roll when the missed season lands in the data. See docs/ACCURACY-LEDGER.md section 6. Keys beginning with underscore are ignored. Remove an entry once the player is active again.

Ricky Pearsall.note: PCL surgery, out for 2026. Confirmed via team announcement. VERIFY before the 6 Sep freeze that this is still accurate and that no other confirmed season-enders are missing from this file — anything stale at freeze time is frozen permanently.

Ja'Lynn Polk.note: Retired / roster status NA — will not play in 2026. Confirmed by Steve 20 Aug 2026.

Jayden Higgins.note: Torn ACL in the 18 Aug joint practice vs LV, MRI-confirmed 19 Aug. Out for 2026. Reported by NFL Network (Rapoport), ESPN, CBS, NBC and the Houston Chronicle. NOTE: no ripple entry was added for Houston's remaining pass-catchers — deliberate, see the freeze checklist.
